name: Pigeonhole Partition Obfuscation
description: Replaces explicit subgraph edge counts or neighbor-equality conditions with a bipartite-partition constraint on a fixed-size subset. It forces the model to mathematically prove to itself that "impossible to 2-color a 3-vertex graph" is strictly equivalent to "is a K3 clique" before it can write an efficient algorithm, defeating models that rely on direct translation of problem rules into code.
